## Columns

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From REST `composite_ticker`: "The stock ticker symbol used to identify this ETF on exchanges." | REST |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose spelling the library cannot read as the dataset's class (its `Symbol` is then null); null on every other row. Present unless the session's `unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, which fails on such a row instead. | REST |
| `EffectiveDate` | String | The date showing when the information was accurate or valid; some issuers, such as Vanguard, release their data on a delay, so the effective_date can be several weeks earlier than the processed_date. | REST |
| `FundFlow` | double | The net daily capital flow into or out of the ETF through the creation and redemption process, where positive values indicate inflows and negative values indicate outflows. | REST |
| `Nav` | double | The net asset value per share, representing the per-share value of the ETF's underlying holdings. | REST |
| `ProcessedDate` | String | The date showing when ETF Global received and processed the data. | REST |
| `SharesOutstanding` | double | The total number of ETF shares currently issued and outstanding in the market. | REST |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. | REST |
